content.text: The verifier's only failure is a parser artifact — the period is spelled in words with no numeral. I'll add the numeral while keeping the edit surgical.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformance warranty in Section 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months, consistent with our position that delivered software and work product carry a twelve-month conformance warranty; the Section 19.4 repair, replacement and refund remedy is unchanged. If a twelve-month period is difficult, we can accept ninety (90) days for non-software Deliverables provided software-bearing Deliverables carry twelve (12) months.
input.summary: Extend Deliverable conformance warranty period from ninety days to twelve (12) months in Section 19.2.
